---- Respondents (Cause title taken from Case Information System) For Petitioners : Mr. Sabyasachi Bhaduri,
Advocate For State/Respondent No.1 : Mr. Gurudev I. Sharan, G.A.

For Respondent No.2 : Mr. K.K.
Pandey, Advocate Hon'ble Shri Ramesh Sinha, Chief Justice Hon'ble Smt. Rajani Dubey, Judge Order on Board Per Ramesh Sinha, Chief Justice 18.07.2023

Heard Mr. Sabyasachi Bhaduri,
learned counsel for the petitioners.

Also heard Mr. Gurudev I. Sharan, learned Government Advocate, appearing for the State/respondent No. 1 and Mr. K.K. Pandey, learned counsel for respondent No.2.
1.

By way of this writ petition, the petitioners have prayed for following reliefs:
10.1
That, Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to call for the entire record including diary of FIR No. 203/2019 registered at PS Pamgarh, District- Janjgir-Champa u/s 498A & 34 of the IPC.

10.2 That, Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to quash the chargesheet and all the consequential proceedings arising out of the FIR No. 203/2019 registered at PS Pamgarh, District- Janjgir-Champa u/s 498A & 34 of the IPC.

(10.3) That, Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to grant any other relief in favour of the petitioner as the Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the present matter."

2. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this petition with liberty to file the petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C.
3.

Mr. Gurudev I. Sharan, learned G.A., appearing for the State/respondent No.1 and Mr. K.K.
Pandey, learned counsel for respondent No.2 have no objection.
4. Accordingly, the instant petition is dismissed with the aforesaid liberty to the petitioners.

Sd/- Sd/-
 (Rajani Dubey) (Ramesh Sinha)
